name: If Text Contains
description: Route text to exactly one branch based on a keyword or regular expression match.

outputs.name: true
outputs.description: Input text when the condition matches.

outputs.name: false
outputs.description: Input text when the condition does not match.

outputs.name: selected
outputs.description: Selected branch name: true or false.

parameters.name: keyword
parameters.description: Keyword or regular expression to match.

parameters.name: regex
parameters.description: Interpret keyword as a regular expression.
